# Z.AI Developer Documentation

> Complete API reference and developer guides for Z.AI's GLM family of language and vision models, from quick start to advanced agentic engineering.

Z.AI provides comprehensive documentation for integrating GLM foundation models (GLM-5, GLM-4.x series) and vision-language models into applications. The docs cover API setup, model selection, pricing, migration paths, and real-world integration examples with tools like Claude Code and Cline.

## Key Topics

- GLM-5
- GLM-5-Turbo
- GLM-4.5
- GLM-4.6
- GLM-4.7
- GLM-4.6V
- Function Calling
- Multimodal AI
- Vision-Language Models
- Agentic Coding
- API Reference
- OpenClaw
- GLM-OCR
- Tool Invocation
- Context Window

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/quick-start): Quick start guide for Z.AI API setup and GLM model integration
- [Overview](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/overview): Z.AI model overview covering GLM-5, vision, and agent tools
- [API Introduction](https://docs.z.ai/api-reference/introduction): Z.AI Platform API reference with authentication and REST endpoints

## Language Models

- [GLM-5](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5): GLM-5 foundation model overview with agentic engineering capabilities
- [GLM-5-Turbo](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5-turbo): GLM-5-Turbo model with OpenClaw optimization and tool invocation
- [GLM-4.7](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4.7): GLM-4.7 model capabilities for coding, multimodal, and function calling
- [GLM-4.6](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4.6): GLM-4.6 model with context window and coding performance benchmarks
- [GLM-4.5](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4.5): GLM-4.5 model variants with reasoning and tool invocation capabilities
- [GLM-4-32B-0414-128K](https://docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-4-32b-0414-128k): GLM-4-32B model with 128K context window and web search integration

## Vision & Multimodal Models

- [GLM-4.6V](https://docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-4.6v): GLM-4.6V vision-language model with function calling and multimodal
- [GLM-OCR](https://docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-ocr): GLM-OCR model for document parsing and text/table recognition
- [AutoGLM-Phone-Multilingual](https://docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/autoglm-phone-multilingual): AutoGLM mobile assistant for Android device automation and task planning

## API Reference & Configuration

- [Core Parameters](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/concept-param): Core API parameters for model configuration and output generation
- [Pricing](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing): Z.AI pricing for text, vision, image, and audio models in USD

## Integration & Tools

- [Claude Code Integration](https://docs.z.ai/scenario-example/develop-tools/claude): Integration guide for GLM Coding Plan in Claude Code environment
- [GLM Coding Plan Overview](https://docs.z.ai/devpack/overview): GLM Coding Plan overview with pricing and AI coding tool support
- [Migrate to GLM-5](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/migrate-to-glm-new): Migration guide from GLM-4.x to GLM-5 with code examples

## Support & Resources

- [FAQ](https://docs.z.ai/help/faq): Frequently asked questions on billing, rates, and GLM-4.5 usage
